name: DSBench
why_it_matters: Mirrors the newsroom workflow of ingesting messy data, analyzing it, and producing an accurate written summary.
task_shape: Agents are given realistic data science tasks (data analysis and modeling) sourced from ModelOff and Kaggle, requiring them to work with long contexts, multiple files, and produce answers or predictions.
signals: Uses realistic, multi-file tasks with tables, documents, and images rather than toy problems.
State-of-the-art agents solve only a minority of tasks, so scores may be noisy for close comparisons.
